label: Efficiency of esse-causes: q.3 a.4 claim-vs-type gap closed, efficiency typed behind an open bridge
summary: Issue #1633. Materialized and read AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A4: the conclusion 'habeat esse causatum ab alio' and the dichotomy 'causatum ab aliquo exteriori' do not name the mode of causing; the fire example and 'quia Deum dicimus esse primam causam efficientem' suggest an agent. Type inspection: 33ad148b, 4876dc46's conclusion 7561e216 and 2b25a78c on route 3b0f4fa5 are all over the mode-unspecified CausesIn; efficiency is assumed only in the reading step of e7b4c683/358d8c6e that applies e078f07b to CausesIn. Repair: prose of 33ad148b, be639b3f's exterior horn, 7561e216, DEF-EXTERNAL-CAUSE-OF-ESSE, DEF-Q3A4-EXTERNAL-ESSE-CAUSE-MODEL, claims d5239ffd/7b708e93 (attribution recorded), meanings of af503cd7/4876dc46/d3c6a6f7, Lean doc comments of HasExternalEsseCause and ParticipatedHasExternalEsseCause, and 457698e4 now say mode unspecified. Efficiency typed: EfficiencyProfile adds the tenseless primitive EfficientlyCausesEsse (definition 8934912c, deliberately not the secunda via's here-and-now EfficientlyCausesIn); HasExternalEfficientEsseCause is CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6 (definition d8963cdd). Results: 95b40fad (457698e4 + OPEN bridge 58e6ec63 -> 1ff08418), 10c1d8d1 (be639b3f + 61bd42e5 + bridge -> 1ff08418, composing the existing transcription theorem), a2d5d89d (1ff08418 strengthens 33ad148b), 3f0a91c1 (0cc3a136 strengthens 58e6ec63), controls 23792412. Non-efficient control: every mode-unspecified input and conclusion of both source routes holds, both bridges and 1ff08418 fail. Existing premises excluding it: none on the route; e0088de9 would only with an unstated tense bridge, since its EfficientlyCausesIn is here-and-now. Rejected: reusing DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING (imports present causing, #1616); rebinding 33ad148b (frozen consumers); the existential bridge (makes the derivations transcriptions). Strongest rival to the bridge: a non-agent principle of esse, either a constituent form counted as a being (the typed bridge's c != x is broader than q.3 a.4's 'exteriori') or a non-agent exterior exemplar; price: show how a non-agent accounts for x's being actual rather than specifying it. Note docs/notes/esse-cause-efficiency-1633.md.
blocker: The efficiency gap is not closed on the root route: the no-component-first-being arguments e7b4c683 and 358d8c6e apply 'an efficient cause is prior' (e078f07b) with the mode-unspecified CausesIn as its cause relation; connecting that step to 1ff08418 needs efficient siblings of 7561e216/2b25a78c and of those arguments. The efficient route into 33ad148b adds no support to it (33ad148b and 457698e4 are the same proposition, otherActualCauseIffExternalCause, relation logically_equivalent_to). The bridge 58e6ec63 and its unrestricted version 0cc3a136 are OPEN. Next tests: restrict the bridge to non-constituent causes (needs a constituency relation on the profile); derive it from a specify-versus-actualize principle; state the tense bridge from the secunda via's here-and-now EfficientlyCausesIn to EfficientlyCausesEsse so that 1ff08418 can feed the order of efficient causes.
